description: Source file implementing MediaEngineExtension class for Windows media rendering, handling media source creation, shutdown, and type support.

classes.name: MediaEngineExtension
classes.description: Class managing media source creation and lifecycle for Windows media engine.

methods.name: RuntimeClassInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the media engine extension class.

methods.name: CanPlayType
methods.description: Checks if a MIME type can be played; here, always returns not supported.

methods.name: BeginCreateObject
methods.description: Begins asynchronous creation of media source object.

methods.name: CancelObjectCreation
methods.description: Cancels media object creation; not supported, returns unexpected.

methods.name: EndCreateObject
methods.description: Completes asynchronous creation of media source object.

methods.name: SetMediaSource
methods.description: Sets the media source for the extension.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the media engine extension, releasing resources.
